title: Bao bench result document
description: Machine-readable result format for issue #19 Phase A. One document per bench per run, emitted to stdout by bench-harness, persisted as bench/results/<date>-<commit>/<bench>.run-<k>.json. Normative companion: bench/METHODOLOGY.md.

schema_version.description: Bump on any breaking shape change; consumers must pin-check.

benchmark.description: Stable benchmark id; matches the harness subcommand.

parameters.description: Benchmark inputs (iterations, warmup, budgets, payload sizes). Values are numbers or strings.

metrics.description: At least one metric on success; may be empty when top-level error is present.

notes.description: Honest disclosures: shared host, tail shape, cold-sample caveats, observed anomalies.

error.description: Present iff the bench failed (fail-closed); process exit code must be non-zero alongside.

cargo_profile.description: e.g. test-ci / release. Cross-profile comparison is forbidden (METHODOLOGY.md section 2).

display.description: DISPLAY value; null when not set. Browser benches run under xvfb-run.

name.description: Stable metric id within the benchmark, snake_case.

unit.description: SI unit registry; see METHODOLOGY.md section 4.

phase.description: Absent for metrics where cold/warm does not apply (RSS phases, throughput totals).

cv.description: stddev/mean; unstable iff cv > 0.05 for run-median class metrics.

unstable.description: cv gate flag; unstable results are ineligible for comparison/regression adjudication until re-run.

samples.description: Optional raw samples; emitted when n <= 2000 for auditability.
